facts.value: The Unibator serves as an 'incubator for innovation' at Goethe University, supporting students, staff, and alumni in bringing scientific findings and business ideas to marketable products and services.
AndersGründer project in the Social Impact Lab Frankfurt helps startups in founding their social enterprises, providing coaching, training, co-working, and access to relevant networks.
Colleges in the FrankfurtRheinMain region are collaborating to create a central internet portal to support startup initiatives from the academic environment.
Offers include incubators, accelerators, funding program advice, cooperation opportunities with external partners from business and science, competitions, and founder awards.
Offers are also available for interdisciplinary and cross-university team building.
